<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 600" width="640" height="600">
  <defs>
    <pattern id="hatch" width="12" height="10" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M0 10 L6 0" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="640" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <g font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#000000">

    <!-- bench with hatch marks below it -->
    <path d="M30 536H540" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="30" y="536" width="510" height="10" fill="url(#hatch)"/>

    <!-- Bunsen burner and flame -->
    <rect x="132" y="500" width="48" height="36" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polygon points="141,500 171,500 156,446" fill="#9a9a9a" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="231" y="475">heat</text>

    <!-- tripod and gauze -->
    <path d="M102 428L75 536M210 428L237 536M84 428H228" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>

    <!-- round-bottomed flask with sea water -->
    <path d="M96.3 356H215.7A60 60 0 1 1 96.3 356Z" fill="#e0e0e0"/>
    <path d="M96.3 356H215.7" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <path d="M135.5 305.6A60 60 0 1 0 176.5 305.6" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <path d="M135.5 305.6V212M176.5 305.6V212" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="135" y="194" width="42" height="18" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="156" y="391" text-anchor="middle">sea water</text>

    <!-- thermometer through the stopper, bulb level with the side arm -->
    <path d="M156 241V134" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="156" cy="248" r="7" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <path d="M156 146H102" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="96" y="151" text-anchor="end">thermometer</text>

    <!-- side arm leading down to the right into the condenser -->
    <path d="M176.5 248L234 258.8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>

    <!-- Liebig condenser labelled X -->
    <polygon points="253.4,236.5 421.4,332.5 394.6,379.5 226.6,283.5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <path d="M244.4 252.2L412.4 348.2M235.6 267.8L403.6 363.8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <path d="M337.2 284.6L366 233" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="370" y="228">X</text>

    <!-- cooling water: in at the lower end, out at the upper end -->
    <path d="M370.8 421.1L394.6 379.5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <polygon points="394.6,379.5 393.5,390.4 385.7,385.9" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="364" y="426" text-anchor="end">water in</text>
    <path d="M253.4 236.5L277.2 194.9" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <polygon points="277.2,194.9 276.1,205.8 268.3,201.4" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="277" y="180" text-anchor="middle">water out</text>

    <!-- condensate drips into the conical flask of pure water -->
    <path d="M408 362V386" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="2 3"/>
    <path d="M396 392V422L354 536H462L420 422V392" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="456" y="487">pure water</text>

    <!-- caption -->
    <text x="276" y="578" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15">Fig. 4.1</text>
  </g>
</svg>
